name: decider
tagline_zh: 架构决策总在聊天记录里失踪？用它一键生成ADR，自动维护索引，旧决策被推翻时还能追踪替代关系，让每次选择都有据可查。
tagline_en: Lost architectural decisions in chat? Generate ADRs in one click, auto-maintain index, and track superseded.
desc_en: Architecture Decision Record (ADR) and architectural decision document management: templates, creation, search, supersession tracking, and INDEX maintenance.
why_zh: 同类工具只存模板，它却把ADR生命周期管到底：从创建到作废，索引自动更新，替代关系一目了然。
why_en: Unlike template-only tools, it manages the full ADR lifecycle—creation, supersession, and auto-index—so decisions never orphan.
